annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones (MinTIC), Colombia
key_provisions_or_claims: Colombia launched the Estrategia Nacional Digital 2023-2026 with eight axes, including AI, data, and digital security and trust.
The strategy includes 100 actions and 13 indicators.
It plans a public policy roadmap for responsible development and adoption of AI.
It plans a governance model to coordinate and monitor digital transformation initiatives.
Targets include raising internet accesses from 38 million to over 71 million and training 797,000 people in digital skills.
annotation.summary_en: MinTIC news release announcing Colombia's National Digital Strategy 2023-2026, a roadmap on connectivity, data, digital security, skills and AI to close digital gaps. It foresees a public policy roadmap for responsible AI adoption and a governance model. No robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Inteligencia Artificial, innovación y datos, las apuestas para volver a Colombia una PotencIA Digital
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence, innovation and data: the bets to make Colombia a Digital PotencIA
